verdict.rationale: SIP and telephony bridging is a fair question for a real-time communications platform, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions SIP, trunking, PSTN or carrier interoperability. The WebSocket media adapters and voice-only sessions are adjacent building blocks, not documented SIP interop.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, the service documents SIP interoperability with my existing trunking or telephony provider rather than locking me to one carrier
